patterns: APPSC asks AP economy as single-figure recall tied to a specific Survey/estimate: sector shares of GVA at current prices for a named year (2021-22 services 42%; 2022-23 36.19/23.36/40.45), 'record growth 11.43% in 2021-22', 'first in GSDP growth 2015-16', 'only state with double-digit growth 2015-16'.

Match-the-following of sector/sub-sector to growth or share (2023-24 AE growth rates; 2024-25 sub-sector GVA shares: communications 2%, construction 8%, horticulture 10%, fishing 9%) is a recurring format; options are permutations of the same numbers.

Vision documents are asked by target year (Vision 2029: most preferred investment destination by 2050; 2029 targets list) and Swarna Andhra basics (10 Padi Sutralu, P4 aim); not by rupee/dollar milestones.
Trap is always the estimate stage and price basis: livestock leads at current prices, fishing at constant; AE vs FRE figures differ, so the year+stage must match the key.

The app's coverage of figures is good, but it leans on 2026 bulletins (CM review orders, SES tabling date, national services index, PLFS) and multi-statement items mixing several Survey tables, which APPSC does not do; undated 'what is AP's X' one-liners are risky because the keyed answer changes with each Survey.
